record.question: What is the role of the President or Governor under the proviso to Article 309 in the absence of any law by the legislature?
options: To make rules for public services until the legislature passes a law
To take over the responsibility of appointing all public servants
To dismiss any public servant who does not follow the rules
To delegate the power to local authorities
